meta.name: audit
meta.description: Use when someone asks for an AIOS audit, asks to score their setup against the Four Cs, or says "is my AIOS working" / "audit my setup" / "find gaps in my AIOS". Produces a Four-Cs scoreboard with top-3 fixes ranked by leverage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估你的 AIOS 设置并给出改进建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想知道自己的 AIOS 配置是否合理并找到改进方向。
copy.tagline_en: Audit your AIOS setup and get improvement suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know if your AIOS setup is sound and find ways to improve.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会对你当前项目的 AIOS 设置进行四维评分（上下文、连接、能力、节奏），并给出得分最高的三个改进建议。
howto.when: 当你询问“我的 AIOS 工作正常吗”、“审计我的设置”或要求对 AIOS 进行评分时触发。

say.text: 审计我的 AIOS 设置
say.note: Claude 会扫描项目文件并输出评分报告。

say.text: 我的 AIOS 工作正常吗？
say.note: Claude 会运行四维审计并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scores your current project's AIOS setup across four dimensions (Context, Connections, Capabilities, Cadence) and provides the top three leverage-weighted improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "is my AIOS working", "audit my setup", or request an AIOS audit or scoring against the Four Cs.

say_en.note: Claude scans project files and outputs a score report.
Claude runs the Four Cs audit and suggests improvements.
